testResult.scope: Installed Brickwright Circuit tab; real palette, learner program, switch/LED nets, shared clock and File menu

checks.name: Full host palette places the Microtronic with its 24-key front panel
Run applies the visible program draft and executes it on the installed engine
Program file input works and an invalid draft leaves the accepted program intact
Visible switch contacts drive IN1/IN3 through the drawn circuit and light external LED faces
Independent CLOCK reaches IN4 and changes OUT4 through the loaded echo program
Opening a physical switch removes its input and extinguishes the corresponding external LED
Halt, Step and Reset operate on the computer while preserving the independent circuit clock
Physical keypad NEXT commits a word into both the running model and the saved circuit source
Unloaded editor text survives live rerenders and Run executes the retained draft
The real File menu saves and reopens the wired circuit with its accepted program, which runs again

scopeNote: This receipt qualifies the recorded production tree. It is not a full repository CI verdict or a public deployment claim.
